stemMd: What is the distance between points (−1,2) and (5,10)?
explanationMd: The coordinate differences are 6 and 8. Distance is the square root of 6 squared+8 squared, or 10. The two perpendicular components form a right triangle.

distractorRationale.b: This uses only the vertical difference.
distractorRationale.d: This adds coordinate differences rather than using Euclidean distance.
distractorRationale.a: This uses only the horizontal difference.
